description: The key fix only changes newly generated provision scripts. Hosts provisioned earlier keep /etc/apt/sources.list.d/dply-mysql.list with the expired key and continue to break day-two package operations until something removes it. Add an idempotent detect-and-repair operation (day-two job or remediation) that reports what it found and what it removed. The provision-time pruner covers a re-provision; this covers hosts nobody re-provisions.
title: Repair stale MySQL APT sources on already-provisioned hosts
